minutes.headline: Select Board and Planning Board held an economic development workshop with no vote; another session is planned.
minutes.summary: Public comment on town center plans and social media tone opened the night, then a joint workshop on economic development. The land use director reviewed past plans, zoning limits and infrastructure, and members and residents discussed ecotourism, farming, a business group and surveying residents. The board then approved warrants and minutes and discussed scheduling a pilot agreement hearing.

Asked what the center district bylaw intended and what the boards' visions for economic development are.
Treatment of Stillman Country Fair versus the Unifier festival; agri-tourism.
Parking is needed before reusing town center buildings.

what_happened.line: The Select Board and Planning Board held a joint economic development workshop and took no vote on it.
The land use director reviewed past plans, zoning limits and infrastructure, and members and residents then discussed ideas without a resolution.
The boards agreed to hold another meeting with other involved entities on action items, leaving the format, charrette or workshop, open.
Public comment covered town center plans, 40R zoning and rules affecting farm and small food businesses; 40R was said to apply only to Tri Town Landing.
The board read payroll and accounts payable warrants into the record and handled the minutes; the vote count was not audible.

why_it_matters: Economic development and zoning choices for the town center and local farm and food businesses were discussed but not decided, so any change would come through later meetings and, for zoning, a vote at Town Meeting.
The warrants approved are how the town's bills and payroll are paid from the town budget, mostly taxes.
